channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-28318 — SolarWinds Serv-U
item.description: Threat Signal 66. SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-105134 — Ahsay AhsayCBS
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

item.title: CVE-2018-19943 — QNAP Network Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2022-38181 — Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain root privilege and/or disclose information.

item.title: CVE-2026-85102 — Check Point Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

item.title: CVE-2026-83548 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 66. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-48939 — iCagenda iCagenda
item.description: Threat Signal 66. iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-12641 — Roundcube Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Roundcube Webmail contains an remote code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code via shell metacharacters in a configuration setting for im_convert_path or im_identify_path.

item.title: CVE-2023-2868 — Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) appliance contains an improper input validation vulnerability of a user-supplied .tar file, leading to remote command injection.

item.title: CVE-2021-39144 — XStream XStream
item.description: Threat Signal 77. XStream contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate the processed input stream and replace or inject objects that result in the execution of a local command on the server. This vulnerability can affect multiple products, including but not limited to VMware Cloud Foundation.

item.title: CVE-2022-33891 — Apache Spark
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Apache Spark contains a command injection vulnerability via Spark User Interface (UI) when Access Control Lists (ACLs) are enabled.

item.title: CVE-2010-1428 — Red Hat JBoss
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Unauthenticated access to the JBoss Application Server Web Console (/web-console) is blocked by default. However, it was found that this block was incomplete, and only blocked GET and POST HTTP verbs. A remote attacker could use this flaw to gain access to sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2015-0311 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2017-11317 — Telerik User Interface (UI) for ASP.NET AJAX
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Telerik.Web.UI in Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX allows remote attackers to perform arbitrary file uploads or execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2022-26143 — Mitel MiCollab, MiVoice Business Express
item.description: Threat Signal 77. A vulnerability has been identified in MiCollab and MiVoice Business Express that may allow a malicious actor to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information and services, cause performance degradations or a denial of service condition on the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2020-1956 — Apache Kylin
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Apache Kylin contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could permit an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-10174 — NETGEAR WNR2000v5 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 77. The NETGEAR WNR2000v5 router contains a buffer overflow which can be exploited to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2015-1187 — D-Link and TRENDnet Multiple Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 77. The ping tool in multiple D-Link and TRENDnet devices allow remote attackers to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-6332 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 77. OleAut32.dll in OLE in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to remotely execute code via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2009-0927 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Stack-based buffer overflow in Adobe Reader and Adobe Acrobat allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2017-0101 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 77. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows Transaction Manager improperly handles objects in memory.

item.title: CVE-2019-11581 — Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center contain a server-side template injection vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2015-1701 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 77. An unspecified vulnerability exists in the Win32k.sys kernel-mode driver in Microsoft Windows Server that allows a local attacker to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2015-2051 — D-Link DIR-645 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 77. D-Link DIR-645 Wired/Wireless Router allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a GetDeviceSettings action to the HNAP interface.

item.title: CVE-2020-5722 — Grandstream UCM6200
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Grandstream UCM6200 series is vulnerable to an unauthenticated remote SQL injection via crafted HTTP request. Exploitation can allow for code execution as root.

item.title: CVE-2014-1776 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2019-10758 — MongoDB mongo-express
item.description: Threat Signal 77. mongo-express before 0.54.0 is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via endpoints that uses the `toBSON` method.

item.title: CVE-2018-14847 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 77. MikroTik RouterOS through 6.42 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files and remote authenticated attackers to write arbitrary files due to a directory traversal vulnerability in the WinBox interface.

item.title: CVE-2019-3398 — Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a path traversal vulnerability in the downloadallattachments resource that may allow a privileged, remote attacker to write files. Exploitation can lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-3161 — Cisco Cisco IP Phones
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Cisco IP Phones contain an improper input validation vulnerability for HTTP requests. Exploitation could allow an attacker to execute code remotely with root privileges or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

item.title: CVE-2019-4716 — IBM Planning Analytics
item.description: Threat Signal 77. IBM Planning Analytics is vulnerable to a configuration overwrite that allows an unauthenticated user to login as "admin", and then execute code as root or SYSTEM via TM1 scripting.

item.title: CVE-2018-0798 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way objects are handled in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user. This vulnerability is known to be chained with CVE-2018-0802.

item.title: CVE-2020-8644 — PlaySMS PlaySMS
item.description: Threat Signal 77. PlaySMS contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-31755 — Tenda AC11 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

item.title: CVE-2019-9082 — ThinkPHP ThinkPHP
item.description: Threat Signal 77. ThinkPHP contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via public//?s=index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]= followed by the command.

item.title: CVE-2020-17496 — vBulletin vBulletin
item.description: Threat Signal 77. The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2019-16759.

item.title: CVE-2021-27561 — Yealink Device Management
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-82078 — PaperCut NG/MF
item.description: Threat Signal 76. PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

item.title: CVE-2026-73570 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

item.title: CVE-2026-55040 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft SharePoint contains a weak authentication vulnerability which allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

item.title: CVE-2010-0806 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via vectors involving access to an invalid pointer after the deletion of an object. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-64328 — Sangoma FreePBX
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Sangoma FreePBX Endpoint Manager contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow for a post-authentication command injection by an authenticated known user via the testconnection -> check_ssh_connect() function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to potentially obtain remote access to the system as an asterisk user.

item.title: CVE-2025-34026 — Versa Concerto
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Versa Concerto SD-WAN orchestration platform contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the Traefik reverse proxy configuration, allowing at attacker to access administrative endpoints. The internal Actuator endpoint can be leveraged for access to heap dumps and trace logs.

item.title: CVE-2025-8110 — Gogs Gogs
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Gogs contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting improper Symbolic link handling in the PutContents API that could allow for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-14847 — MongoDB MongoDB and MongoDB Server
item.description: Threat Signal 76. MongoDB Server contains an improper handling of length parameter inconsistency vulnerability in Zlib compressed protocol headers. This vulnerability may allow a read of uninitialized heap memory by an unauthenticated client.

item.title: CVE-2025-14733 — WatchGuard Firebox
item.description: Threat Signal 76. WatchGuard Fireware OS iked process contains an out of bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process. This vulnerability may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code and affects both the mobile user VPN with IKEv2 and the branch office VPN using IKEv2 when configured with a dynamic gateway peer.

item.title: CVE-2025-59718 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchMaster, FortiProxy, and FortiWeb contain an improper verification of cryptographic signature vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass the FortiCloud SSO login authentication via a crafted SAML message. Please be aware that CVE-2025-59719 pertains to the same problem and is mentioned in the same vendor advisory. Ensure to apply all patches mentioned in the advisory.

item.title: CVE-2025-6218 — RARLAB WinRAR
item.description: Threat Signal 76. RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2025-4008 — Smartbedded Meteobridge
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Smartbedded Meteobridge contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote unauthenticated attackers to gain arbitrary command execution with elevated privileges (root) on affected devices.

item.title: CVE-2013-3893 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.
